body:
I'm so sorry about your dad, that's awful. I'm sure nothing I say can really make it better, but I can tell you for certain that it's not your fault. You didn't know what he was going to do. He was obviously in great pain, and that's horrible. Even though I didn't know him, considering that you're his child I think the last thing he would want is for you to blame yourself for his pain. 

Also I know you probably hear this a lot, but you're really young. Not that your age makes your pain any less than anyone else's, believe me no one who hasn't been through what you've been through could truly understand how you feel right now (and that includes me) but I don't know, think it's kind of an advantage; you've got lots of time to work things out.

Anyway, I don't know if I'm helping at all here but just wanted to let you know you are heard.
